neighbours.label: connective (' to', ' when', 'such as') that introduces the task or occasion in which a skill, tool or piece of knowledge is applied ('you will need algebra to calculate…', 'carpenters use geometry when designing…'); quiet on plain narrative 'to'/'when'
fire: You will need statistics to interpret the results of a survey.
Tailors rely on measurement when cutting cloth for a suit.
Students must know their times tables to solve these division problems.
Sailors use knowledge of the tides when planning a crossing.
A good grasp of grammar is needed to write a clear report.
Bakers apply ratios when scaling a recipe for a large order.
Map reading skills are required to navigate the moor safely.
Electricians use Ohm's law when choosing the right fuse.
quiet: We drove to the coast and walked along the pier.
The tailor smiled when the customer left a tip.
The students went to the canteen after the lesson.
The sailors cheered when the harbour came into view.
She wanted to leave before the speeches began.
The baker was asleep when the alarm rang.
They decided to stay on the moor another night.
The electrician laughed when the dog stole his sandwich.

notes: Probes: 'need algebra to calculate' 0.89, 'especially when we doubled a recipe' 0.70, 'use geometry when designing' 0.57, 'rely on trigonometry when plotting' 0.56, 'needed to learn' 0.31; narrative 'when he arrived' 0.15, 'when the postman knocked' 0.09, 'to buy milk' 0.09, 'tried to open' 0.03.
